value: germination of Origanum onites seeds was 83 ± 6% in the control and 89 to 97% in every smoke-water (2.5 and 5%), KAR1 (0.01 and 0.1 µM), mandelonitrile and KAR1 + mandelonitrile treatment, all carrying the same letter a as the control (no treatment differed from the control, p < 0.01; null)
method: seeds incubated on moistened filter paper with distilled water (control), wheat-straw smoke-water (2.5 and 5%), KAR1 (0.01 and 0.1 µM), mandelonitrile (MAN, 5 and 50 µM) or KAR1 + MAN combinations (K-1: 0.01 + 5 µM; K-2: 0.1 + 50 µM); germination (radicle emergence) counted twice weekly for 5 weeks
conditions: 20 °C in darkness; 3 replicates of 25 seeds; fruits collected July and August 2016 from open Pinus brutia forest and maquis at Mugla-Marmaris, Turkiye, stored dry at room temperature until December 2016; control germination was already high (83%), so the absence of a smoke effect leaves little room for stimulation; the table's letters mean rows sharing a letter do not differ significantly (p < 0.01); in the same paper smoke-water raised germination in Ballota acetabulosa, Phlomis lycia and Stachys cretica subsp. smyrnaea and KAR1 in the first and last, so this null is for this species only; columns are Kontrol, DS (%) 2.5 and 5, KAR1 (µM) 0.01 and 0.1, MAN (µM) 5 and 50, KAR1 + MAN K-1 and K-2
